description: Angular component class for updating JSON attribute widget settings in Thingsboard UI, including form initialization, default settings, validation triggers, and dynamic validators.

classes.name: UpdateJsonAttributeWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending WidgetSettingsComponent for managing widget settings form related to JSON attribute updates.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for widget settings.

methods.name: onSettingsSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided settings.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form controls that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on current form values.
